d: For years, the world has been obsessed with artificial intelligence. Now, Cambridge Dictionary has picked a rather interesting Word of the Year for 2026: Human. As machines learn to write, create, speak and even imitate our thinking, the word “human” is appearing in places where it was never needed before. But what does this choice say about the world we are living in? And why has being human suddenly become something we need to spell out? Palki Sharma explains.
